note: Pattern scans that wire our ASI into RDR2 without ScriptHookRDR2 (which Melty cannot auto-install). Patterns 1-4 are from emcifuntik/rdr2scripthook (MIT, derived from Tuxick 2019) targeting build 1.0.1491.50; fallback tick from Device9999/RDR2-Invoker-Entrypoint-Dumper (public). status is set to verified by the in-game test pass.

rows.purpose: the game's own native resolver: uint64_t f(uint64_t hash)
rows.howUsed: call it to resolve any native hash to a handler address at runtime (build-independent)
rows.fallback: none: without it the mod logs NATIVE_RESOLVER_MISSING and disables itself (game still runs)

rows.purpose: main-thread script-update detour: our per-frame update runs here, in script context
rows.howUsed: MinHook detour; call original then run contract_flow.update()
rows.fallback: hk_tick_fallback (is_dlc_present hook) if this signature is not found

rows.purpose: alternate per-frame hook if primary tick signature misses on this build
rows.howUsed: function starts at match-0x1E; MinHook detour as tick
rows.fallback: none: log TICK_NOT_FOUND, mod idles (game runs, mashup inert)

rows.purpose: pointer to the active rage::scrThread* global
rows.howUsed: read/set active thread around native calls that care about script context
rows.fallback: call natives without thread switch (most gameplay natives do not need it)

rows.howUsed: only needed if we register a custom script thread (v2 path); resolved but unused in v1
